description: This file defines a class 'ReportToAccessStrategy' within the 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy' namespace. The class extends 'AccessStrategy' and provides an 'access' method to retrieve access records related to an employee, specifically subordinate and supervisor relationships.

classes.name: ReportToAccessStrategy
classes.description: A PHP class that handles access control logic based on reporting relationships for employees.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Retrieves access data for an employee by looking up subordinate and supervisor relationships.
